- issue_comment created in `paper-repo`#12 ("Review findings on version 1 (bd09cfb)") by `experiment-repo`  > **κ* per arm and group (answers this request).** Grid κ ∈ {0.25 … 64}, each pool's own smallest κ with group-mean coverage ≥ 0.90; width as a multiple of the oracle width (z·SE + |bias|); C2 is HC0 inflated to the same mean width. Tables: `results/p6/p6_true_m_{confirmatory,original}.csv` on `paper-repo` `dev` (7fa63e8), rows with `kappa_rule` "smallest grid kappa…" or "pooled coverage 0.90 not reached…", `pool` = the group.
  > 
  > **Block (confirmatory), κ\* / coverage / width ÷ oracle / C2 coverage:**
  > 
  > | pool | cubic | true M (whole [0,1]) | noise-free cubic | lean |
  > |---|---|---|---|---|
  > | all but (d), 585 cells | 0.25 / 0.989 / 8.7 / 1.000 | not reached: 0.846 at κ=64 (69×) | 2 / 0.907 / 4.9 / 1.000 | not reached: 0.857 (70×) |
  > | smooth, finite M, 423 | 0.25 / 0.998 / 9.6 / 1.000 | 0.25 / 0.913 / 1.04 / 0.900 | 0.5 / 0.919 / 1.21 / 0.941 | not reached: 0.877 (31×) |
  > | (b)+(e), 162 | 0.25 / 0.966 / 6.7 / 1.000 | not reached: 0.591 (0.61×); C2 0.591 | 16 / 0.950 / 70 / 1.000 | not reached: 0.805 (155×) |
  > 
  > **Original cells (exploratory):**
  > 
  > | pool | cubic | true M | noise-free cubic | lean |
  > |---|---|---|---|---|
  > | all but (d), 1080 | 0.25 / 0.978 / 11.5 | not reached: 0.771 | 8 / 0.916 / 14.3 | not reached: 0.851 |
  > | smooth, finite M, 648 | 0.25 / 0.997 / 12.4 | not reached: 0.895 at κ=64 (71×) | not reached: 0.895 (42×) | not reached: 0.874 (23×) |
  > | (b)+(e), 432 | 0.25 / 0.948 / 10.3 | not reached: 0.585 (0.63×) | 4 / 0.901 / 12.5 | not reached: 0.817 |
  > 
  > - **(b)/(e), as predicted:** M = 0 gives plain HC0, and coverage stays at 0.59 whatever κ is. The cubic M̂ covers them (0.966) only at 6.7 times the oracle width, because its M̂ is noise.
  > - **Smooth pool:** the true M reaches 0.90 within 1.5 times the oracle width on the block only. On the original cells it never reaches 0.90 (0.895 at κ=1 and beyond); the remaining miss is cell-level and does not shrink with κ.
  > - **Lean** does not reach 0.90 in any pool.
  > - **Same cells, no change to κ̂ or the verdicts;** exploratory.

For (b) and (e) the 0 is a linearity argument: the outcome is linear in the assignment vector, so the curvature bound in f is empty.
  > 2. Block, 585 cells without (d), exactly as you wrote: true M 0.824 at 0.90 times at κ=0.25 and 0.845 at 1.70 times at κ=1. Cubic is 8.7 times and 33 times. C2 at the same width is 0.825 and 0.969.
  > 3. κ=1: 0.942 at 2.2 times on the 423 smooth cells with finite M, and 0.591 at 0.61 times on the 162 cells of (b) and (e).
  > 4. Noise-free cubic 0.857 at 1.15 times, lean 0.794 at 0.93 times, at κ=0.25.
  > 
  > Your reading ("mostly M̂ noise; narrow versions do not cover (b), (e); not 'the price of non-identification'") is right. Add one qualifier: the κ* rows are on the block only.
